paragraphs: R. Naḥum: R. Idi bar Gershon said: R. Levi ben Perata said: R. Naḥum said: R. Birim said (see his entry). R. Zeira sent him to R. Yannai son of R. Yishmael, Jerusalem Talmud, Ta'anit 2, halakhah 2; Berakhot 4, mishnah 3. In R. Ḥiyya bar Ba's name, Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of HaMokher Et HaBayit. In Shemuel bar Abba's name, Jerusalem Talmud, Keitzad Me'abberin.
